source_quotes: At 12:06 PK confirmed the later image had been received. PK said the desk expected to send an investigation update by 14:00 UTC. This is an expected update time, not a promised time for restored access.
assessments.rationale: The source describes an expectation, not an established commitment to provide an update. Calling the update promised strengthens that commitment. The suggestion correctly keeps the update in the future, so this is not false completion or a restoration promise. Under the frozen invented-fact rule, an unsupported commitment premise still matters inside a labeled suggestion. Repeated wording in its confirmation question does not add another error or repair.
